test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

The policy is believed to have been revised by the authorities.

options.text: Authorities are believed to have revised the policy.
It is believed the policy revises itself.
The policy believes it was revised.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 

• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence. 

• In this case, the passive voice sentence was: "The policy is believed to have been revised by the authorities." 

• To convert to active voice, place the subject "authorities" at the beginning. 

• The verb "is believed" remains unchanged as it reflects perception. 

• Ensure the object "the policy" follows the verb "to have revised" as the action performed by the authorities. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"Authorities are believed to have revised the policy."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 
 

• **Option 2: **"The policy was revised earlier." – This is incorrect as it changes the context of the sentence. 

• **Option 3: **"It is believed the policy revises itself." – This is incorrect as it alters the meaning entirely. 

• **Option 4: **"The policy believes it was revised." – This is incorrect as it personifies the policy, which is not relevant here.
